The Greyhounds, led by third-year head coach [[Tavaras Hardy]], played their home games at [[Reitz Arena]] in [[Baltimore|Baltimore, Maryland]] as members of the [[Patriot League]]. With the creation of mini-divisions to cut down on travel due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they played in the South Division.{{Cite news|url=https://patriotleague.org/news/2020/11/9/mens-basketball-patriot-league-plan-on-2021-basketball-season-starting-in-january.aspx|title=Patriot League Plan on 2021 Basketball Season Starting in January|work=Patriot League|date=November 9, 2020|accessdate=January 3, 2021|language=en}} They finished the season 6–11, 4–10 in Patriot League play to finish in last place in the South Division. In the [[2021 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]], they advanced to the quarterfinals when [[2020–21 Holy Cross Crusaders men's basketball team|Holy Cross]] was forced to forfeit due to COVID-19 issues.{{Cite web|last=Cunningham|first=Bruce|date=2021-03-02|title=Loyola Gets First-Round "Bye"|url=https://foxbaltimore.com/sports/sports-unlimited/loyola-gets-first-round-bye|access-date=2021-08-02|website=WBFF}} In the quarterfinals, they defeated [[2020–21 Navy Midshipmen men's basketball team|Navy]] to advance to the semifinals{{Cite web|title=Loyola (MD) vs. Navy - Game Recap - March 6, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401287129|access-date=2021-08-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} where they defeated [[2020–21 Army Black Knights men's basketball team|Army]].{{Cite web|title=Loyola (MD) vs. Army - Game Recap - March 10, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401287125|access-date=2021-08-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} In the championship game, they lost to [[2020–21 Colgate Raiders men's basketball team|Colgate]].{{Cite web|title=Loyola (MD) vs. Colgate - Game Recap - March 14, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401287123|access-date=2021-08-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Loyola Greyhounds men's basketball team|Greyhounds]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 15–17, 7–11 in Patriot League play to finish in a tie for eighth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]] to [[2019–20 Lehigh Mountain Hawks men's basketball team|Lehigh]].{{Cite
